title: Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers
abstract: arXiv:2611.34680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-vi

translated_title: 神经渲染编译器：将生成式视频模型作为可编程渲染器
translated_abstract: 生成式视频模型正成为强大的渲染器，但缺乏传统系统（如 HTML/CSS 引擎或 Blender）所具备的可预测控制接口。它们的能力是隐式地从训练中产生的，因此难以确定它们能够可靠执行哪些任务。我们提出了神经渲染编译器，它通过自动探测冻结的视频模型来构建模型特定的能力手册，描述该模型能够可靠满足哪些语义需求。NeurCo 将用户意图表示为与模型无关的中间表示，涵盖对象、约束、事件和相机，然后将其编译为模型特定的执行策略。可靠的需求保持不变，而不可靠的需求则被选择性地重写或编译为替代执行策略。我们引入了 VComBench，这是一个包含 380 个组合式多需求任务的基准测试，涵盖文本生成视频、图像生成视频和参考生成视频等模态。
tldr: NeurCo 提出了一种神经渲染编译器，通过自动探测冻结视频模型构建能力手册，并将用户意图编译为模型特定的执行策略，从而为生成式视频模型提供可预测的编程式渲染控制。
en_tdlr: NeurCo introduces a neural rendering compiler that automatically probes frozen video models to construct capability manuals and compiles user intent into model-specific execution strategies, enabling predictable programmatic control over generative video models.
